oewn-02670095-v.why: The note paraphrases the gloss's 'trust' and 'confidence' and then invents a contrast with 'the bare depend', but depend in this sense only exists with 'on', so the claimed extra firmness is a property of the gloss wording, not of the word.
oewn-02670095-v.tone: Spells out both the trust and the assurance behind it, firmer and more deliberate than the bare *depend*.

oewn-05621958-n.why: The note calls the word a 'neutral faculty-name' while the entry's charge is positive, so the note and the charge contradict each other on the one thing the charge is meant to record.
oewn-05621958-n.definition: the mental ability to understand and discriminate between relations
oewn-05621958-n.tone: The British spelling of the same neutral faculty-name, adding nothing to *judgment* but a letter.

oewn-05623283-n.why: 'Named off the adjective' is a derivation story about where the word came from rather than what it does, the same class as 'back-formation'; the register contrast with discretion would stand on its own.
oewn-05623283-n.definition: knowing how to avoid embarrassment or distress
oewn-05623283-n.tone: The same avoidance named off the adjective, drier and more clinical than *discretion*.
